insights.content: On insider selling: Many VDs/entrepreneurs start from nothing with 100% equity - they should be allowed to take money off the table after success. Insider buys are more meaningful signals than sells. Small 'dutting' purchases by executives with million-dollar salaries are meaningless.

analysis_summary: Episode 270 of Gott och Blandat focuses on Danish small-cap holdings (Trophy Games, Hov, Free Trailer) with recent positive guidance updates, followed by an extensive iGaming regulatory update covering US state-by-state legalization prospects (Maine passed, Virginia/Indiana/New York likely), Latin American tax changes (Colombia, Brazil), and surprising growth markets (Saudi Arabia, Philippines, Greece). The hosts maintain high conviction in their Danish portfolio holdings based on conservative management guidance and strong operating leverage. Birthday celebration segment provides insight into Erik's investment philosophy favoring Swedish small-caps and simple, disciplined approaches.
